40: def _obj(fp, obj, **dict):
41:     fp.write("%d 0 obj\n" % obj)
42:     if dict:
43:         fp.write("<<\n")

53: # (Internal) Image save plugin for the PDF format.
54: 
55: def _save(im, fp, filename):
56:     resolution = im.encoderinfo.get("resolution", 72.0)
57: 
58:     #
59:     # make sure image data is available
60:     im.load()
61: 
62:     xref = [0]*(5+1) # placeholders
63: 
64:     class TextWriter:
65:         def __init__(self, fp):
66:             self.fp = fp
67:         def __getattr__(self, name):
68:             return getattr(self.fp, name)
69:         def write(self, value):
70:             self.fp.write(value.encode('latin-1'))
71: 
72:     fp = TextWriter(fp)
73: 
74:     fp.write("%PDF-1.2\n")
75:     fp.write("% created by PIL PDF driver " + __version__ + "\n")
76: 
77:     #
78:     # Get image characteristics
79: 
80:     width, height = im.size
81: 
82:     # FIXME: Should replace ASCIIHexDecode with RunLengthDecode (packbits)
83:     # or LZWDecode (tiff/lzw compression).  Note that PDF 1.2 also supports
84:     # Flatedecode (zip compression).
85: 
86:     bits = 8
87:     params = None
88: 
89:     if im.mode == "1":
90:         filter = "/ASCIIHexDecode"
91:         colorspace = "/DeviceGray"
92:         procset = "/ImageB" # grayscale
93:         bits = 1
94:     elif im.mode == "L":
95:         filter = "/DCTDecode"
96:         # params = "<< /Predictor 15 /Columns %d >>" % (width-2)
97:         colorspace = "/DeviceGray"
98:         procset = "/ImageB" # grayscale
99:     elif im.mode == "P":
100:         filter = "/ASCIIHexDecode"
101:         colorspace = "[ /Indexed /DeviceRGB 255 <"
102:         palette = im.im.getpalette("RGB")
103:         for i in range(256):
104:             r = i8(palette[i*3])
105:             g = i8(palette[i*3+1])
106:             b = i8(palette[i*3+2])
107:             colorspace += "%02x%02x%02x " % (r, g, b)
108:         colorspace += b"> ]"
109:         procset = "/ImageI" # indexed color
110:     elif im.mode == "RGB":
111:         filter = "/DCTDecode"
112:         colorspace = "/DeviceRGB"
113:         procset = "/ImageC" # color images
114:     elif im.mode == "CMYK":
115:         filter = "/DCTDecode"
116:         colorspace = "/DeviceCMYK"
117:         procset = "/ImageC" # color images
118:     else:
119:         raise ValueError("cannot save mode %s" % im.mode)
120: 
121:     #
122:     # catalogue
123: 
124:     xref[1] = fp.tell()
125:     _obj(fp, 1, Type = "/Catalog",
126:                 Pages = "2 0 R")
127:     _endobj(fp)
128: 
129:     #
130:     # pages
131: 
132:     xref[2] = fp.tell()
133:     _obj(fp, 2, Type = "/Pages",
134:                 Count = 1,
135:                 Kids = "[4 0 R]")
136:     _endobj(fp)
137: 
138:     #
139:     # image
140: 
141:     op = io.BytesIO()
142: 
143:     if filter == "/ASCIIHexDecode":
144:         if bits == 1:
145:             # FIXME: the hex encoder doesn't support packed 1-bit
146:             # images; do things the hard way...
147:             data = im.tostring("raw", "1")
148:             im = Image.new("L", (len(data), 1), None)
149:             im.putdata(data)
150:         ImageFile._save(im, op, [("hex", (0,0)+im.size, 0, im.mode)])
151:     elif filter == "/DCTDecode":
152:         Image.SAVE["JPEG"](im, op, filename)
153:     elif filter == "/FlateDecode":
154:         ImageFile._save(im, op, [("zip", (0,0)+im.size, 0, im.mode)])
155:     elif filter == "/RunLengthDecode":
156:         ImageFile._save(im, op, [("packbits", (0,0)+im.size, 0, im.mode)])
157:     else:
158:         raise ValueError("unsupported PDF filter (%s)" % filter)
159: 
160:     xref[3] = fp.tell()
161:     _obj(fp, 3, Type = "/XObject",
162:                 Subtype = "/Image",
163:                 Width = width, # * 72.0 / resolution,
164:                 Height = height, # * 72.0 / resolution,
165:                 Length = len(op.getvalue()),
166:                 Filter = filter,
167:                 BitsPerComponent = bits,
168:                 DecodeParams = params,
169:                 ColorSpace = colorspace)
170: 
171:     fp.write("stream\n")
172:     fp.fp.write(op.getvalue())
173:     fp.write("\nendstream\n")
174: 
175:     _endobj(fp)
176: 
177:     #
178:     # page
179: 
180:     xref[4] = fp.tell()
181:     _obj(fp, 4)
182:     fp.write("<<\n/Type /Page\n/Parent 2 0 R\n"\
183:              "/Resources <<\n/ProcSet [ /PDF %s ]\n"\
184:              "/XObject << /image 3 0 R >>\n>>\n"\
185:              "/MediaBox [ 0 0 %d %d ]\n/Contents 5 0 R\n>>\n" %\
186:              (procset, int(width * 72.0 /resolution) , int(height * 72.0 / resolution)))
187:     _endobj(fp)
188: 
189:     #
190:     # page contents
191: 
192:     op = TextWriter(io.BytesIO())
193: 
194:     op.write("q %d 0 0 %d 0 0 cm /image Do Q\n" % (int(width * 72.0 / resolution), int(height * 72.0 / resolution)))
195: 
196:     xref[5] = fp.tell()
197:     _obj(fp, 5, Length = len(op.fp.getvalue()))
198: 
199:     fp.write("stream\n")
200:     fp.fp.write(op.fp.getvalue())
201:     fp.write("\nendstream\n")
202: 
203:     _endobj(fp)
204: 
205:     #
206:     # trailer
207:     startxref = fp.tell()
208:     fp.write("xref\n0 %d\n0000000000 65535 f \n" % len(xref))
209:     for x in xref[1:]:
210:         fp.write("%010d 00000 n \n" % x)
211:     fp.write("trailer\n<<\n/Size %d\n/Root 1 0 R\n>>\n" % len(xref))
212:     fp.write("startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % startxref)
213:     fp.flush()

cwe_assessments.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The code formats palette RGB values into a PDF ColorSpace field using string formatting. CWE-74 requires special elements that could modify parsing/interpretation downstream. The demonstrated mechanism is formatting data into a structured field, but no evidence shows palette values contain PDF special characters (parentheses, brackets, slashes) that would affect PDF parsing.

connection.evidence: Palette data from im.im.getpalette("RGB") is directly formatted into colorspace string, which is written to PDF file via _obj() function. The path from source (palette) to sink (PDF ColorSpace field) is direct and demonstrated.

diff_causality.evidence: The candidate line is part of constructing the PDF ColorSpace definition for palette images. If reverted, palette colors would not be included in the PDF, breaking indexed color support. The line materially contributes to the data flow being examined.

security_control.required_control: Neutralization of PDF special characters (parentheses, brackets, slashes, whitespace) in palette values before inclusion in ColorSpace field
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-74 requires neutralization when data containing special elements modifies parsing. PDF ColorSpace field syntax uses parentheses, brackets, and slashes as delimiters. Palette values formatted as hex could contain characters affecting parsing if palette data is malformed.
existing_controls_checked: No validation/sanitization of palette values before formatting
Latin-1 encoding in TextWriter only affects character encoding, not PDF syntax
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No validation or sanitization is applied to palette RGB values. However, evidence does not demonstrate that palette values can contain PDF special characters - RGB values from i8() are 0-255 integers formatted as hex, producing only hex digits 0-9a-f and spaces. No evidence shows palette data can be maliciously crafted to inject PDF syntax.

concrete_impact.evidence: No demonstrated security consequence. The formatted hex values (00-ff) and spaces do not contain PDF special characters that would modify parsing. Without evidence that palette data can contain malicious content, impact remains speculative.

cwe_assessments.diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, palette RGB values would not be formatted into the colorspace string, breaking indexed color (mode P) image support in PDF output.
